templateId.note: The website's design. Chosen when the site is made; never changed by editing.

businessName.note: The business name in the header and footer (required).

statusText.note: Badge in the header, e.g. Open now · until 18:00. Empty hides it.

hours.note: Short opening hours, e.g. 9:00 – 18:00. On the live site the Owner Portal's hours replace it.

hoursDetail.note: The full week's hours. On the live site the Owner Portal's hours replace it.

address.note: The shop's address, also used for directions. On the live site the Owner Portal's address replaces it.

phones.note: Up to 3 phone numbers. On the live site the Owner Portal's phone replaces them.

email.note: Contact email; empty hides it. On the live site the Owner Portal's email replaces it.

telegram.note: Telegram username without @. Empty hides it.

facebookUrl.note: Facebook page, https:// only. Empty hides it.

instagramUrl.note: Instagram page, https:// only. Empty hides it.

logoUrl.note: Round logo in the header, from the Owner Portal; null or missing shows the template's mark.

currency.note: Currency of the prices (USD or KHR). Set by the business, not by editing.

palette.note: Colour palette; original keeps the template's own colours.

accentColor.note: Accent colour #rrggbb overriding the palette; null keeps it.

backgroundColor.note: Background colour #rrggbb overriding the palette; null keeps it.

textColor.note: Text colour #rrggbb overriding the palette; null keeps it.

font.note: Font pairing; original keeps the template's own.

buttonStyle.note: Button corners: square, rounded or pill.

align.note: Text alignment of the block: left, center or right.

spacing.note: Space above and below the block: tight, normal or roomy.

eyebrow.note: Small label above the heading. Empty hides it.

description.default: One or two sentences about what you offer and why people love it.
description.note: One or two sentences under the headline.

primaryLabel.note: Text of the main button. Empty hides it.

primaryAction.note: Where the button goes: shop (the products), visit (the Visit us block), call, email or directions (Google Maps). There is no free-form link.

secondaryLabel.note: Text of the second button. Empty hides it.

secondaryAction.note: Where the button goes: shop (the products), visit (the Visit us block), call, email or directions (Google Maps). There is no free-form link.

imageUrl.note: The main picture: an uploaded file (/…) or an https:// link; null shows the template's placeholder.

sideImages.note: Up to 4 extra pictures some templates show beside the main one, each with an optional short label.

highlights.note: Up to 3 short facts some templates show as chips or a strip under the headline.

badge.note: Short text in a round badge or tag (some templates). Empty hides it.
